summary: Sega AM1's 1995 arcade motorcycle racer, a bike-based spiritual successor to OutRunners with digitized graphics and route-branching stages.

entries.title: Cool Riders

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or original hardware; MAME support matured years after initial emulation work because of the H1 Board's unique graphics compression.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Sega H1 Board arcade presentation with modern scaling

primary.version: Original Sega H1 Board arcade release
primary.why: Cool Riders is sourced as a 1995 Sega arcade racing game on the unique Sega H1 Board, with Arcade as its only documented platform. With no sourced home ports or alternate releases, the arcade version is the definitive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original arcade version in MAME/original hardware; use linked cabinets where available for multiplayer.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced home port or remaster.
